neighbours.label: an evaluative adjective before a noun meaning notable or gladly received (a welcome addition, a marked improvement, a decided advantage)
fire: The new library is a welcome change for the students of the town.
Doctors noticed a marked decline in cases after the campaign.
Cool rain brought welcome relief after weeks of heat.
The extra staff gave the hospital a decided advantage that winter.
Her quiet humour was a welcome break from the long meeting.
The report shows a marked rise in sales since the spring.
The free shuttle is a welcome addition to the festival.
There has been a marked shift in public opinion on the issue.
quiet: The new library is a big change for the students of the town.
Doctors noticed a slow decline in cases after the campaign.
Cool rain fell again after weeks of heat.
The extra staff gave the hospital more beds that winter.
Her quiet humour was a part of every long meeting.
The report shows a rise in sales since the spring.
The free shuttle is a new addition to the festival.
There has been a shift in public opinion on the issue.
